---
title: Downhill lie
summary: Ball on a slope running down toward the target — expect a lower, running shot.
category: lies
tags: [slope, ball-position, balance]
aliases: [ball on a downslope]
level: all
clubs: [irons, hybrids]
setup:
  - Tilt your shoulders to match the slope.
  - Play the ball a little back of normal.
swing:
  - Swing along the slope.
expect:
  - Lower flight and more roll than normal.
mistakes:
  - Leaning back to help the ball up.
club_choice: Take one club less.

The slope delofts the club.
